=====================================================================
 Scarface RngGuard
=====================================================================

What this is
-------------
A small fix for a crash in Scarface: The World Is Yours (v1.0.0.2) that
happens when the game loads a mission after you die - it crashes on the
loading screen. The cause is the game's ambient population ("world
ambience") spawner using a broken list of spawn candidates.

This plugin stops that crash without modifying scarface.exe in any way.

Requirements
-------------
- Scarface: The World Is Yours, patch 1.0.0.2
- An ASI loader. If you use SilentPatch or Scarface Fusion Fix you already
  have one (vorbisfile.dll in the game folder).

Installation
-------------
1. Copy Scarface.RngGuard.asi into the folder that contains scarface.exe.
   (You can also put it in the "scripts" subfolder.)
2. Start the game.

That's it. No other files are required.

Settings
-------------
On the first start, Scarface.RngGuard.ini is created next to scarface.exe.
The only setting most people need:

    [General]
    Logging=1

        Logging=1  -> write Scarface.RngGuard.log (default)
        Logging=0  -> do not write a log file

Everything else in the file can stay as it is.

The log file is limited to 1 MB by default. When it reaches that size it is
renamed to Scarface.RngGuard.log.old and a new log is started, so it will not
fill up your disk.

If the game is installed in a folder Windows does not let you write to (for
example "C:\Program Files"), the log is saved in
%LOCALAPPDATA%\ScarfaceRngGuard\ instead.

Still crashing?
-------------
Send Scarface.RngGuard.log (and Scarface.RngGuard.log.old, if present).
It records the crash address and call stack, which is enough to identify
which part of the game failed.

Uninstall
-------------
Delete Scarface.RngGuard.asi, Scarface.RngGuard.ini,
Scarface.RngGuard.log and Scarface.RngGuard.log.old.
